label: Iron or garment steamer

questions.text: How many times a week is it used?
questions.why: Heavy use wears the soleplate and heater.

questions.text: What water goes in the steam tank?
questions.why: Hard water leaves scale that blocks the steam holes.

answers.label: Filtered or the type the manual says

questions.text: Is it ever left on and unattended?
questions.why: An unattended hot iron is a fire risk.

questions.text: Is the power cord in good condition?
questions.why: Damaged cords are a shock and fire risk.

questions.text: How is it stored after use?
questions.why: Storing it hot or with water inside causes damage.

questions.text: Have you noticed leaks, spitting water, a burning smell or sparks?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the iron before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the iron yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Don't bypass or tamper with the thermostat or any safety cut-out.
care_tips.why: These stop the appliance overheating; without them it can cause burns or a fire.

care_tips.text: Unplug the iron whenever you step away.
care_tips.why: An unattended hot iron can start a fire.

care_tips.text: Stop using it if the cord is worn or damaged, and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Damaged cords can cause shocks and fires.

care_tips.text: Use the type of water your manual recommends.
care_tips.why: Hard water leaves scale that blocks the steam holes.

care_tips.text: Let it cool and empty the tank before putting it away.
care_tips.why: Water and heat left inside cause damage.

care_tips.text: If it sparks or smells of burning, unplug it and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a dangerous fault.

reminders.text: Run the iron's self-clean or descale as your manual describes.
reminders.interval_text: about once a month for steam irons
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

risk_factors.reason: An unattended iron is a fire risk.

risk_factors.reason: A damaged cord is a shock and fire risk.

risk_factors.question: symptoms
risk_factors.reason: These are signs of a fault.
